fragment: precision highp float; varying vec2 vTextureCoord; uniform sampler2D uTexture; uniform sampler2D uTexture2; uniform float uProgress; void main() { if (uProgress < 0.5) { gl_FragColor = mix(texture2D(uTexture, vTextureCoord), vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0), uProgress*2.0); } else { gl_FragColor = mix(vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0), texture2D(uTexture2, vTextureCoord), (uProgress-0.5)*2.0); } }
